primary_rule: one-sided paired-root t test versus zero, 95% two-sided interval, no confirmatory inference if any incomplete roots or mechanism mismatches; report resource cap and target failure
auxiliary: assigned-slot interaction, equal-fee equal-degree random exchange comparator, fee response and access are descriptive
natural_stop: common addressed 1.5% end hazard and administrative cap; early stop remains assigned, no nonexistent offer is included in eligible rate
scope: conditional, funded single-slot C/D study; synthetic continuation noise 10%; no online model requests
